claims.claim: Reviewers note that matches quickly become chaotic with heavy visual clutter when multiple ultimate abilities are used simultaneously.

citations.review_text:
Easily the most fun i've had in a hero shooter since early overwatch. Having the entire roster unlocked from the start without any grind is a massive W, and the team-up abilities actually make you feel like you're playing comic book characters instead of generic shooter classes.
That said, matchmaking in quick play can be super sweaty and the visual clutter gets pretty wild when twelve ults go off on point. Also good luck getting anyone to play vanguard when half the lobby instalocks duelist.
Still totally worth downloading since it's free and the battle passes don't expire. 10/10 would solo tank while spider-man swings into a 1v6 again.
The character selection and abilities are okay, but the matches can become chaotic very quickly. It's enjoyable in short sessions, although it doesn't always keep me interested.

claims.claim: Reviewers highlight that all characters are unlocked completely free right from the start without requiring any grinding.

citations.review_text:
From the moment it dropped on December 5, 2024, the biggest win for me was the roster. You get all 30+ heroes and villains completely free right from the start. There is no annoying grinding to unlock your favorites, which is such a breath of fresh air. It really feels like your favorite comic book pages coming to life. Flying over the map as Iron Man while watching Spider-Man swing through the chaos below just never gets old.
The 6v6 gameplay is fast and incredibly fun. The maps, especially spots like Tokyo 2099, feature destructible environments that make every match feel dynamic,. What really sets this game apart for me are the "Team-Up" abilities. Being able to pair Rocket Raccoon with the Punisher to trigger an unlimited ammo buff adds a whole new layer of strategy that feels uniquely Marvel.
Yes, people compare it a lot to Overwatch, and it definitely shares that DNA, but it brings its own unique flavor. Honestly, the absolute best part is how the game respects your time. The battle passes never expire, so there is zero FOMO. You can just play at your own pace without stressing over a ticking clock.
While the giant visual brawls can sometimes get a little too chaotic on the objective, the game is a total blast. For the price of free, Marvel Rivals is an easy recommendation and exactly what the multiplayer scene needed right now.

[b]RATING: 7/10[/b]

Super exhilarating and completely free hero shooter, where every character is unlocked from the very start  plus a Battle Pass that never expires, offering a foundation they can build on for years ahead.

Sure, there’s room to fine-tune optimization and balance, but what truly sets this game apart  and what they have absolutely nailed  is the rock-solid server stability. Not once have I been disconnected since launch. That’s nothing short of incredible. Truly outstanding work!
great game very balanced all characters unlocked at start

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game suffers from poor optimization, frequent crashes, and performance issues that worsen with patches.

citations.review_text: THIS STUPID UNOPTIMIZED GAME CRASHING WHEN WE COULD HAVE WON

This game is not worth your time. I've played competitive online shooters for over a decade, with my main ones over the years being OW, Siege, and finally Rivals. 

Do not give your time or money to this company or product. Rivals is terribly optimized, poorly balanced, and has some of the worst matchmaking you'll ever experience. If you are looking for a game to sink some time into to get good at and play competitively, this is without a shadow of a doubt not the game for you. This game does not respect your time or you. NetEase does not want to make the best hero shooter they can- they want your money and the game is a means towards that end. Their monetization practices are becoming increasingly anti-consumer and their transparency with the player-base is dwindling. The developers are genuinely, impressively incompetent at everything they do besides making pretty cosmetics and maps.

Don't waste a minute of your life playing this game that doesn't respect you enough to fix the performance issues and visual clutter that get worse every patch. This game has some of the most inane, incomprehensible, incompetent balance posts you'll ever have the displeasure of experiencing in-game. 

As of November 2026 this game is not worth your time. I think it'll take the developers a couple months (6+) to get the game to a fun, competitive state if they start yesterday. My words here can only describe a fraction of how utterly abysmal this game has become. Absolutely heartbreaking to see one of my favorite games become such complete and utter garbage. 

I hope this review has saved you from spending time playing this game if you were on the fence. ggs NetEase

I don't normally review games. I don't care too. However I am 1k hours into this game. 

Do not recommend. Ultimately its the terrible matchmaking that is the problem. Additionally, several if not almost most matches is filled with bots that CANNOT match the skill of the player. 

The biggest thing for me lately is the game is updating non-stop requiring more and more of my computer which is causing it to crash. You know who gets penalized? ME. I get banned from playing for my computer crashing! 
We are up to an hour of ban time right now, and it is only going to increase.

This game had potential, but whether it's Disney forcing them to spread themselves thin to focus on promoting a movie or the Devs just not caring, this game lost a lot of what made it shine. It's got a big toxicity problem and every time I hear the devs say they'll punish it more I can still bet on hearing a slur get unpunished the next day. It runs poorly even on a high end PC and any optimization updates they have barely work and stop working completely after a month. Balance is genuinely the worst I've seen in any game ever and I played Destiny 2 PVP for years, but don't worry, Our prehistoric pal is shedding a tiny bit of bulk to keep things fair and balanced.

I will continue to keep playing this game, not because it is a good game, but because I want it to be. But as of right now I could not recommend it to anyone.

Marvel Rivals is a game that started off as a breath of fresh air and rapidly devolved into a suffocating toxic wasteland.
What began as an incredibly fun, fast-paced hero shooter has quickly been ruined by a total failure to manage the game's health. You will face catastrophic, world-ending threats in every single match. Unfortunately, those threats are not Thanos. They are just an unholy mix of broken matchmaking, high-rank smurfs, and an explosion of unpunished aimbots.

The Matchmaking: Perfectly Unbalanced

• The Daycare Protocol: The system regularly pairs one high-ranked solo player with four toddlers chewing on their controllers. You are not playing a hero shooter. You are running an underfunded daycare in a war zone.
• The Forced Cooldown: If you accidentally win two games in a row, the algorithm panics and throws you into a woodchipper of Top 500 sweatlords while your teammates play via a Smart Fridge.

Ranked Mode: The Grand Delusion

• The Smurf Invasion: Low-tier ranked lobbies are entirely compromised by Top 500 players who get bored of their own queue times. They create fresh accounts to ruthlessly stomp casual players for sport, turning Bronze to Diamond games into an absolute slaughterhouse.
• Bloated Tiers: Thanks to an ELO system that aggressively hands out points for wins while barely scratching you for losses, the actual ranks are hopelessly bloated. Gold is the new Bronze, and Celestial is just Platinum with a massive ego.
• The Spreadsheet Meta: Competitive integrity is non-existent because sweaty stacks use third-party trackers to ban your favorite hero before the gates even open. You lose to an Excel spreadsheet rather than superior strategy.

The Cheater Uptick: Peak Tactical Apathy

• The Hitlist: Aimbots and wallhacks have turned specific hitscans into literal boss fights. You will regularly face a Hawkeye who never misses a pixel, a Punisher whose turret tracks at the speed of sound, and a Luna Snow who lands every single ice shard into …

This game is ded. This game is not ded. Doesn't matter anymore.

The matchmaking is terrible... I know it's nothing new for competitive games, but in Marvel Rivals, it's even worse.

The game is coded for a 50% WR, and most people don't even know how the game works. They know the heroes' abilities and all that, but they don't understand what they're doing. This is not just a hero shooter; it's a team-based game.

And if they were Bronze or something, I could still let it slide, but this goes all the way up to Grandmaster, maybe even higher. Idk.

So yeah, matchmaking is not just something to complain about anymore. It makes the game unplayable.

1. Balance is a joke. Nothing actually dies because supports heal 10 trillion health a second, but you blow up in an instant because every poke character in the game does 8 trillion damage a second. Auto-aim characters are buffed by giving more invincibility moves and damage. Every poke character has a stun and an evasive move so you can never actually solo dive them unless they are literally asleep.

2. Matchmaking is a joke. No role lock/limits means you queue into a match with 5 dps and 1 support ad infinitum. Your opponents will be running a comp that is meta at the highest level. You will get effortlessly rolled while the enemy team asks if you're a bot. Speaking of bots, everytime you get rolled you get matched into a game against bots to boost your ego and drive engagement. I used to think it was just a myth, but you will see the enemy team have names that are TyrPre or similar naming convention of 1 capital letter, 2-3 lowercase letters, then 1-capital letter and 2-3 lowercase letters. You will effortlessly stomp these bots so victory is cheap and hollow.

3. Ranked is a joke. The rank system rewards time played and not actual skill. You can easily climb to GM+ by just grinding because you will win more elo then you actually lose. Meanwhile, your teammates will crash out and purposefully throw the game over the slightest provocation. I had an Iron Man throw the game because he died twice in a row, and then spend the rest of the game on Venom and literally walk into the enemy team to feed ult charge. claims.claim: Reviewers describe character balancing as poor, noting that certain heroes require little skill to dominate while others are neglected or demand strict meta adherence.

citations.review_text: They refuse to effectivly nerf anything, several characters are always strong because they fear when the characters have a low win rate and think they need buffs when really the strong oppresive characters are in dire need of nerfs.

This may be the worst balancing I have ever EVER seen in a game. It's so obvious that the developers care so much more about money than balancing. You're either dealing with a devil dino who clicks Q and wins the game, a storm who clicks Q and wins the game, a Pheonix who for some reason they thought needed Anti-Heal, gambit who consistently runs games and it becomes whoever has the better gambit wins. 

Every other ultimate is a click Q win the game with 0 skill. Lets look at old overwatch. Majority of the ults in that game, you had to use a little brain power to get kills on. This game? Absolutely not. You just click Psylocke Q and move towards people. You click storm Q and locate a healer. You click Devil Dino ult and run towards the healers. AND THERE IS NOTHING TO BE DONE ABOUT IT UNLESS YOU HAPPEN TO HAVE MORE Qs than the enemy team. 

Then, the community. There is a mass amount of DPS players so much so that at Diamond, you see a message that says "you're ranked higher than like 90% of other players!" AND GUESS WHAT. IT'S STILL 3 DPS COMPS BECAUSE NO ONE WILL PLAY ANOTHER ROLE. 

I have decided this game is not worth any time or money unless the developers do something about it. Role Q was the best thing they ever added to overwatch and they need to add it to this game as well. I'm tired of playing with 3 dps players who won't play any other role and still are terrible at theirs. 

If the Developers want to make this game good, they need to seriously sit down and balance the game. It is in the worst state I have seen it since the start.

This game is not worth your time. I've played competitive online shooters for over a decade, with my main ones over the years being OW, Siege, and finally Rivals. 

Do not give your time or money to this company or product. Rivals is terribly optimized, poorly balanced, and has some of the worst matchmaking you'll ever experience. If you are looking for a game to sink some time into to get good at and play competitively, this is without a shadow of a doubt not the game for you. This game does not respect your time or you. NetEase does not want to make the best hero shooter they can- they want your money and the game is a means towards that end. Their monetization practices are becoming increasingly anti-consumer and their transparency with the player-base is dwindling. The developers are genuinely, impressively incompetent at everything they do besides making pretty cosmetics and maps.

Don't waste a minute of your life playing this game that doesn't respect you enough to fix the performance issues and visual clutter that get worse every patch. This game has some of the most inane, incomprehensible, incompetent balance posts you'll ever have the displeasure of experiencing in-game. 

As of November 2026 this game is not worth your time. I think it'll take the developers a couple months (6+) to get the game to a fun, competitive state if they start yesterday. My words here can only describe a fraction of how utterly abysmal this game has become. Absolutely heartbreaking to see one of my favorite games become such complete and utter garbage. 

I hope this review has saved you from spending time playing this game if you were on the fence. ggs NetEase

1. Balance is a joke. Nothing actually dies because supports heal 10 trillion health a second, but you blow up in an instant because every poke character in the game does 8 trillion damage a second. Auto-aim characters are buffed by giving more invincibility moves and damage. Every poke character has a stun and an evasive move so you can never actually solo dive them unless they are literally asleep.

2. Matchmaking is a joke. No role lock/limits means you queue into a match with 5 dps and 1 support ad infinitum. Your opponents will be running a comp that is meta at the highest level. You will get effortlessly rolled while the enemy team asks if you're a bot. Speaking of bots, everytime you get rolled you get matched into a game against bots to boost your ego and drive engagement. I used to think it was just a myth, but you will see the enemy team have names that are TyrPre or similar naming convention of 1 capital letter, 2-3 lowercase letters, then 1-capital letter and 2-3 lowercase letters. You will effortlessly stomp these bots so victory is cheap and hollow.

3. Ranked is a joke. The rank system rewards time played and not actual skill. You can easily climb to GM+ by just grinding because you will win more elo then you actually lose. Meanwhile, your teammates will crash out and purposefully throw the game over the slightest provocation. I had an Iron Man throw the game because he died twice in a row, and then spend the rest of the game on Venom and literally walk into the enemy team to feed ult charge. The harshest punishment that players who do this receive is a measly 15-minute ban; 1-hour if the AI moderators are feeling a bit mean.
